answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable stake that only unlocks after it completes a run of verified, paid tasks across several epochs. Entry is a narrow inlet: only a few new identities are admitted per epoch, and each must build an attested work trail before it can vote or claim rewards. A sybil farm then faces real cost per fake identity, and the fakes sit exposed like stones on a knoll — easy for peers to spot and prune, since none of them has a history. By dawn of the next epoch, honest agents have proof of work; clones have only locked stakes, which the network slashes.
